faqs.q: Do you do repairs if I fail?
faqs.a: No. It's a test-only station; get repairs elsewhere and come back for the retest. MapQuest mentions a free re-test (confirm with Peng's).
Your registration or DMV renewal notice and payment. The check engine light must be off (on 2000+ cars a lit light fails).

faqs.q: Do you test diesel, hybrid, CNG or out-of-state cars?
faqs.a: Yes, all of those, plus transfer-of-ownership checks.

tool_idea.name: Smog Check Ready? + Walk-in Planner
tool_idea.desc: The user enters model year, fuel type (gas, hybrid, diesel, CNG), vehicle type (car, truck, motor home), the reason (DMV renewal, sale/transfer, out-of-state) and whether the DMV notice says 'STAR'. The tool tells them if Peng's can test it, whether they need an appointment (motor homes), a what-to-bring checklist and a check-engine-light warning. It shows a ballpark total of test plus $8.25 certificate (labeled 'call to confirm'), and a 'best time to walk in' board from the posted hours. It ends with a click-to-call button.
tool_idea.why: It's a pure consumer funnel and it reduces phone questions. It also fits the reviews' 'fast, friendly, short wait' theme. Note: a static demo exists in lead-demo-templates/2026-10-05/pengs-smog-check.

chatbot_training_notes: No email, so the bot answers FAQs and pushes a call to (562) 424-2368. It must not promise a price or a free retest until confirmed.
